title: General bounds on functionals of the lifetime under life table constraints in a joint actuarial-financial framework
abstract: arXiv:2603.06238v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In life insurance, life tables provide survival probabilities at integer ages but leave the distribution of deaths within each year unspecified. This incompleteness is particularly relevant for modern insurance products such as variable annuities, whose payoffs depend jointly on lifetime uncertainty and financial market performance. The valuation of such contracts must therefore be carried out in a joint actuarial-financial framework, as their values depend not only on the full information about mortality rates but also on the interaction between mortality risk, asset dynamics and embedded guarantees. Standard approaches impose fractional-age assumptions or mortality rate models, but the resulting valuations strongly depend on these assumptions, which makes it difficult to generalize them. translated_title: 联合精算-金融框架下生命表约束时寿命泛函的一般界
translated_abstract: 在人寿保险中，生命表提供了整数年龄处的生存概率，但并未明确每一年内死亡的分布。这种不完整性对于变额年金等现代保险产品尤为重要，因为此类产品的收益同时取决于寿命不确定性和金融市场表现。因此，此类合约的估值必须在联合精算-金融框架下进行，因为其价值不仅取决于死亡率的完整信息，还取决于死亡风险、资产动态与内嵌保证之间的相互作用。标准方法通常采用分数年龄假设或死亡率模型，但由此得到的估值强烈依赖于这些假设，使其难以推广。为此，我们推导了关于死亡率的寿命混合泛函的上界和下界，这些界与可观测（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文针对生命表仅提供整数年龄生存概率的局限，在联合精算-金融框架下推导出寿命混合泛函（如变额年金合约价值）的上下界，从而摆脱了传统分数年龄假设或死亡率模型导致的估值偏差，使估值结果更具普适性。
